entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Running file-based apps from $PATH can trip up on global.json in current directory #54830
  • Test It_throws_a_warning_when_NuGetPackageRoot_is_empty fails on release/10.0.3xx due to NuGet 7.6 behavior change #54828
  • NavMenu.razor(1,5): error RZ10007: The attribute 'class' is used two or more times for this element. Attributes must be unique (case-insensitive) #54826
  • Test flakiness wiht Microsoft.NET.Build.Tests.GivenThatWeWantBuildsToBeIncremental.ResolvePackageAssets_runs_incrementally #54823
  • Blazor WebAssembly SDK should default MetricsSupport, EventSourceSupport, and HttpActivityPropagationSupport to true #54821
  • Run-file tests failing with "The project file could not be loaded." #54819
  • Flaky test failure: msbuild.binlog file lock (IOException: being used by another process) #54817

Closed

  • NU5128 warning inconsistency? What am I missing? #34859
  • Flaky: BlazorWebAssembly WASM build tests intermittently fail (msbuild /t:Build exit 1) #54814
  • Flaky: Publish ReadyToRun It_supports_crossos_arch_compilation crashes test process (exit code 0) #54818
  • Test flakiness Microsoft.DotNet.Watch.UnitTests.AspireLauncherIntegrationTests.ServerAndResources #54816
  • Flaky: TabCompletionTests.IncludesTemplatesInGroupWithLongEvaluatedConstraints (missing expected completion) #54815
  • Comment/Trailing comma handling in launchSettings.json is not uniform. #54155
  • Flaky: RunFileTests_* (file-based program build) intermittently fail with MSB4025 'project file could not be loaded' #54813
  • Publish Microsoft.NET.TestFramework to nuget.org. #25303
